title: Jasmine Frame
goal: Frame the pond with the existing jasmine plants while keeping the composition light and uncluttered.
currentState: The jasmine plants are currently growing in the large SIP system and will be transferred into the permanent large white planters.

items.note: Transfer from the large SIP system; do not buy replacement jasmine plants.

todos.task: Move existing jasmine plants from the large SIP system into the two large white pots
Install one black trellis for each planter
Position jasmine planters on both sides of the pond
Train jasmine onto the trellises while keeping growth airy

completionMemory.title: End of Phase 5
completionMemory.caption: Existing jasmine transferred into large white planters and trained onto black trellises on both sides of the pond.
